brief: The canvas displays a continuous, uniform grid of interconnected small squares set against a near-black background. Each square exhibits a gentle, steady, inherent pulsation. When the user clicks anywhere on the grid, an expanding wave pulse radiates outward from the point of impact. As this pulse travels, it momentarily passes through the squares, disrupting their normal pattern. Each affected square's inherent breathing rhythm temporarily shifts and becomes localized and unpredictable before smoothly returning to its steady, original beat.

lineage.critique: the same continuous, uniform grid of small, interconnected squares, and this time the disruption from the wave leaves a brief, visible residual shadow on every affected square.

statement: This sketch creates a responsive grid of pulsating squares that react to user interaction. The background is nearly black, with each square gently breathing in a steady rhythm. When clicked, an expanding wave pulse radiates outward from the point of impact, disrupting nearby squares' natural pulsation patterns. Affected squares temporarily lose their consistent rhythm and display erratic behavior before smoothly returning to normal. The visual effect demonstrates both continuous motion and localized disruption, creating an engaging interplay between order and chaos across the canvas.
